name: Achilló
subtitle: Jon's Achilles rehab log
description: Private AltStore source for the Achilló rehab app. Builds are published by the app's build script.

apps.name: Achilló
apps.subtitle: Guided Achilles rehab, by ear
apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Audio rebuilt on native iOS: cues play through the system audio player and the voice through iOS speech, so they no longer fight or stall. Headphones out pauses the session. If audio fails to start you get a Retry button. Lock-screen shows the exercise with working pause/skip. Session controls are proper circles again, and the sound buttons are back.

New look: tab bar (Today, Trends, Log, Settings), three daily rings, one big Next-up button, full-screen sessions with a breathing circle (tap to pause, swipe to skip or go back), quick-one picker as a bottom sheet, and a round-done screen.
Cues that stall (often after the voice speaks) now restart within a second, no need to leave the app and come back.
